body:
Maintainer refresh for the 14:42 review (head b51e899 → **58cab1f**), no force-push.

**Conflicts and fixes**
1. `RECOMMENDED.md` - took main's side; this PR's #157 entry moved verbatim to `docs/decisions/157-debug-info.md` (decisions-per-file rule).
2. `assets/ui/LICENSES.md` - main's lines plus `debug-info.png` in both the "Original artwork" heading and the Tabler "except" list (now `... probe.png and debug-info.png`); the prose count is now **thirteen** and names #108 (probe) and #157.
3. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mod.rs` - module lists keep both sides: `debug_info` beside `stock_info`/`status_alert`; `debug_info_tests` beside `ribbon_icon_tests`, `fresh_op_tests`, `tool_number_tests`, `gate_route_tests`, each with its `#[cfg(test)]`.
4. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs` - `super::debug_info::window(..)` runs before `unsaved_prompt::window(..)`, so the unsaved prompt stays last and on top.
5. `crates/ui/src/state.rs` (overlap with #251) - the State initializer keeps `debug_info_open`/`gpu_line` and #251's `spindle_as_vc`.
6. Snapshots `egui_app.png`, `egui_app_light.png`, `egui_tool_editor.png` - regenerated (`UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1`, CWD `crates/ui`) on origin/main + #213's head. Compared with that tree's goldens, only the right end of the status strip changes.

**Merge-only breakages found and fixed**
- `icons.rs`: `Icon::ALL` was `[Icon; 36]` on both sides (main added `Probe`, this PR added `DebugInfo`), so the merged tree failed to compile. It is now 37 (d529312).
- Status strip (20911d6): under main's long status line (#232/#215 body-ink label), the left-to-right label pushed the right-hand widgets off the strip, and the Debug info glyph was clipped at x≈1268-1271. The right-hand widgets (Debug info door, faint shell label, "Regenerate all stale") are now laid out first. The status line takes the remaining width, truncated with "…", and keeps its full-text hover and "Copy message". The glyph is also tinted with the body ink, because the white-at-load PNG was invisible on the light theme.

**How it was merged.** The branch takes main up to 06a194c, #213's fixed head 19c8ab0 (which carries #232's ce73602) and #251's head 40fd7ba. It does not take the tip of main, because #277/#285 change `.github/workflows/`, which our push token cannot write. No `.github` file changed on the branch. Once #213/#251 merge, this PR still merges cleanly.

**Checks**
- `git merge-tree` of 58cab1f is clean against: origin/main (2db9bcf); main+#213; main+#251; main+#252; and main+#213+#251+#252.

**Tests** (tree = origin/main f7deca0 + #213 19c8ab0 + #251 40fd7ba + #252 8dfcfd7 + this head, byte-identical to the merge-tree result; main has only gained a README change since; CWD `crates/ui`)
```
cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib                          : 279 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored (snapshots match)
cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings : clean
```
Note (not acted on): `docs/decisions/157-debug-info.md` still says "no logging framework yet - #163". #222 (tracing) has since landed, so recent log lines could be a follow-up.

<!-- pr-reviewer: fcfabdf7e408147843a2874562dd3845ae415377 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Head `fcfabdf` is a plain merge of current main (`8cf3c90`, which already includes #213, #251 and #252) into the reviewed head `58cab1f`, with no conflicts. It clears GitHub's CONFLICTING state, which came from the branch having two merge bases.

Its tree (`8db51a3`) is byte-identical to the merged tree the review of `58cab1f` ran on:
- camcraft-ui lib: 279 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored, including the snapshot, debug_info and status tests;
- clippy `-D warnings` on camcraft-ui: clean;
- snapshots: only the Debug info glyph and the status strip's "…" cut change; the full text stays readable on hover and in "Copy message".

So that review's verdict carries over unchanged. The non-blocking notes stand: the decision file's stale "#163" line, and `panes.rs` size.

<!-- review-cost: estimated -->
**Estimated agent cost:** ~$0.59 (rough estimate from size: 254 changed lines)

No token usage was recorded for this PR, so this is calibrated from PRs with measured cost (our fix PRs, fix agent + review: median ~$1.20, ~$2.33 per 1,000 changed lines; floor $0.15, cap ~$3.60). For a contributor's PR it estimates what writing and reviewing it the way our agents work would cost, not what their session actually spent.

Blended upper estimate: 90 % input / 10 % output at list price (Opus 5.5 ~$5.60/M, Sonnet 5.5 ~$2.80/M, Haiku 5.5 ~$0.14/M). Cache reads make the real cost lower; main-session coordination isn't counted.
